% Paths that split before a macro (here: by how many groups they opened)
% meet a conditional inside it at the same place. They are siblings, not
% passes of a loop. With six paths, the fourth sibling forced a summary
% (limits.widen_after = 3), and the summary must not skip the code after the
% conditional, nor leak the definition made in the macro's own group.
\documentclass{article}
\newdimen\uw \uw=\pdfelapsedtime sp
\newcount\un \un=\pdfelapsedtime
\def\clamp#1{\ifdim#1<\uw #1=\uw\fi}
\def\body{\begingroup\clamp{\dimen0}\def\southwest{}\endgroup\gdef\after{}}
\def\apart{\ifcase\un\or\g\or\g\g\or\g\g\g\or\g\g\g\g\or\g\g\g\g\g\fi}
\let\g\begingroup
\def\run{\apart\global\let\after\undefined\body
  \ifx\after\undefined\else\gdef\AfterOnEveryPath{}\fi
  \ifx\southwest\undefined\gdef\AfterSouthwestLocal{}\fi}
\run
\gdef\SatexReachedEnd{}
\end{document}
